## Summary

Describe the paper or website change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Paper `id` matches its filename.
- [ ] Scope and paradigm follow the repository definitions.
- [ ] Front Matter includes every required field.
- [ ] The note includes all required research sections.
- [ ] Claims are neutral and traceable to original sources.
- [ ] Generated README index blocks and `src/generated/` were not edited manually.
- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass locally, when Node.js is available.
